provider.description: OdonataCentral is an online biodiversity information system focused on dragonflies and damselflies. It supports occurrence records, atlas mapping, taxonomic and common-name reference, regional checklists, photo and specimen vouchers, first and seasonal records, projects, contributor accounts, expert review, maps, statistics, downloads, and potential machine interfaces for research, conservation, monitoring, and public participation.
institutional_context: Museums, universities, natural heritage programmes, odonatological societies, and citizen scientists
External biodiversity infrastructures including GBIF, iNaturalist, ITIS, Catalogue of Life, and NatureServe

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting OdonataCentral documentation, records, taxa, classification, common names, atlas maps, checklists, projects, photos, specimens, submission and review workflows, data quality, phenology, habitats, conservation status, APIs, downloads, schemas, licenses, citations, publications, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: OdonataCentral, its editors and regional reviewers, official taxonomic and regional checklists, museum vouchers, published literature, official releases, official API documentation, and cited external authorities remain authoritative for record status, taxonomy, identifiers, versions, licenses, citations, and contact information.
